VBO:0200325.summary: Friendly, active and playful in his rescue’s account, Chesador Prancer had arrived with his brother Blitzen after jumping a five- to six-foot chain-link fence at their previous home. Beagles and Buddies reported that the brothers had stayed inside its fences. Its profile identified four-year-old Prancer as a Labrador Retriever–Chesapeake Bay Retriever cross.
VBO:0200325.shortDescription: Beagles and Buddies described Chesador Prancer as playful and active, with a history of jumping his former home’s fence.
